result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large elevated structure whose support pillars create significant visual obstructions at a wide intersection. While marked crosswalks and traffic signals are present, the scale of the roadway and the deep shadows cast by the overhead infrastructure create a challenging environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated structure block the view between drivers and pedestrians at the corner.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor Visibility/Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows that can make pedestrians less visible to motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the pillars.

interventions.title: Under-deck Lighting
interventions.description: Add high-intensity pedestrian-scale lighting to the underside of the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is located beneath an elevated rail structure, which creates significant visual obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps are present, the massive support pillars and deep shadows compromise overall safety.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large steel pillars supporting the elevated rail structure block the view between drivers on the main road and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, along the roadway

hazards.name: Poor Lighting and Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows on the roadway and sidewalk, potentially reducing pedestrian visibility even during daylight hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to move pedestrians further into the street before crossing, improving their visibility past the pillars and shortening crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically for the sidewalk and crosswalk areas underneath the structure to improve visibility in shadowed zones.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, making them more visible in the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features marked high-visibility crosswalks and curb ramps, but is dominated by a large elevated rail structure that creates significant visual obstructions and shadows. The environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and greenery, resulting in a stark, vehicle-oriented commercial setting.

hazards.name: Elevated Structure Obstruction
hazards.description: The massive steel pillars and overhead structure of the elevated rail line create significant blind spots and deep shadows, reducing visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Add high-intensity lighting to the underside of the elevated structure to eliminate dark shadows and improve nighttime visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk with pedestrian signals and curb ramps, providing basic infrastructure. However, the large support pillars for the elevated structure create significant visual obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Elevated structure pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support columns obstruct the line of sight between motorists and pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway under the elevated tracks

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns into the crosswalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian exposure distance and improve visibility around the pillars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Enhanced Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install additional lighting under the elevated structure to illuminate the crosswalk area.
